Subject: Recap + quick ask from our discovery — Novatech

Hi Samir / Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time today — appreciated the honest discussion about the latency-sensitive recommender workload and the data residency constraints you mentioned. Quick recap from our side and one ask at the end.

Highlights from the call:
- Primary goal: reduce per-recommendation inference latency under 40ms p95 for web sessions, while keeping cost per 1M requests within your Q4 budget target.
- Data constraints: PII must remain in-region; darknet model variants are acceptable if run in a VPC.
- Success metric: decrease total inference spend by >=25% while hitting latency SLO.

What Redwood can bring (brief):
- Unified serving across hosted + private options so you can start on our hosted API and move to a dedicated VPC pool when ready.
- Intelligent batching + KV cache that tends to reduce effective token compute for this profile.
- Quick pilot path (4–6 weeks) to validate latency and unit economics on a representative slice.

Open items we promised to follow up on:
1) Estimated throughput at 40ms p95 for your 4k rps spike profile — attached discovery notes have our rough calc.
2) A short pricing sketch for a pilot and an annual committed lane — see attached pricing deck v2.
3) A list of telemetry we can provide for SOC/audit review if you need it.

Quick ask: does Redwood look directionally like a fit for you? A one-line reply ("fit / maybe / not a fit") is perfect. If "fit" or "maybe", we can lock a 30-min technical pilot planning slot next week.

Proposed 30-min slots (PST):
- Tue 11/09 10:00–10:30
- Wed 11/10 15:30–16:00

Attachments: [attachment: novatech-discovery-notes.pdf (PDF, 120KB)], [attachment: redwood-pricing-deck-v2.pdf (PDF, 250KB)]

Thanks — happy to tailor anything in the notes if you want more detail.

Best,
